title: ctenitis manilensis
intro: Ctenitis manilensis, commonly known as the "Manila Fern," is a species of fern that belongs to the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant is traditionally used in folk medicine, particularly in the Philippines, to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory problems. The health benefits of Ctenitis manilensis include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions in alleviating pain and reducing the severity of infections. The bioactive constituents of Ctenitis manilensis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential benefits in treating various diseases.
